title: Grateful Dead Live at Metropolitan Sports Center on 1973-10-23

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture with crisp, loud Bill drums and Keith’s rare organ on Truckin', delivering an energetic Other One and a riotously funny Casey Jones.
ai_review.review: The recording is a sound‑board source that showcases strong drum presence and surprisingly clear organ work from Keith, though occasional clipping is noted. Musically the show is high‑energy, highlighted by an organ‑spiced Truckin', a soaring Other One jam, and a memorable, security‑guard‑taunting Casey Jones with an interrupted encore.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the show 4–5 stars, praising the creative jams and unique keyboard moments while noting only minor recording glitches; the strong musical performance outweighs the small technical issues.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear mix with loud Bill Kreutzmann drums and prominent Keith organ, but some reviewers report clipping and speaker cracking in parts of the tape.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second‑set jam features a rare Keith organ sound on Truckin' leading into an energetic Other One; the first encore is interrupted by security, adding humor and tension before concluding.

band_member_comments.Phil: Noted for his colorful reaction to a security guard during Casey Jones; no specific playing comments.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith’s unusual organ work on Truckin' and the second‑set jam is repeatedly praised as a unique highlight.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann’s drums are loud and showcase his 1973 jazzy style, considered a highlight of the tape.
